div.h1: Pattern C · A2A inbound (room exposed as an A2A agent)
div.h3: Card discovery + JSON-RPC -> posted in the room

text.tspan: Inbound A2A is fire-and-ack (card advertises streaming=false). The external client
gets an acknowledgment, not the room's eventual reply. As in the outbound direction,
the hub terminates the HTTPS JSON-RPC and records the message in the room itself.

g.text: 6. delivered as a normal room message
